items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: I'm thinking that LaRue was managing the club

ctx.x: At the dreamland. She... May Alex was a schoolgirl then, and I'm thinking that LaRue was managing the club, and May Alex, I think, was going... At the bottom. ...was going to key school, and we was having those... Those...
